gaps: Lint warning in scope (minor): app/(protected)/(tabs)/dashboard/index.tsx:56:28 'spacing' is destructured from useTheme() but never used in the screen body (all spacing in this file is via static StyleSheet literals). Trivial unused-binding cleanup.

Hero card aspectRatio is fixed at 16/11 with no explicit elevation override beyond shadows.lg; spec asked for 'soft elevation' which is satisfied (shadows.lg = offsetY 8 / blur 16 / opacity 0.15), but the card relies on the parent CoverflowCard for scale and does not itself clip the LinearGradient with a borderRadius prop (it is clipped by the imageWrap overflow:'hidden' + borderRadius.xl, which is correct, but worth noting the gradient uses StyleSheet.absoluteFill and depends on the wrapper clip).

borderRadius.xl resolves to exactly 24, which is the low end of the required 24-28 range; in spec but not mid-range. No token between 24 (xl) and 9999 (full) exists, so 24 is the only valid in-range choice.

PresentationCard uses borderRadius.lg (20) for the outer card rather than xl (24) used by HeroCard; this is a deliberate 'distinct treatment' for presentations and is consistent with the preserved special-card intent, but it is a minor radius inconsistency between hero card variants.
DashboardHeader styles.wrap is an empty StyleSheet object ({}); harmless but dead/no-op style entry.
summary: Strong, theme-compliant dashboard redesign that passes both quality gates. ARCHITECTURE: the required component split is fully present and correctly layered - HeroCarousel (owns scrollX, snap geometry, pagination, section title, single-item centering, Presentation special-casing), HeroCard (edge-to-edge expo-image + linear-gradient scrim + status pill + cardState helper), PaginationDots (animated width+color dot), DashboardHeader (thin AppHeader wrapper, internals untouched), CategoryTabs (controlled, reused for in-flow + floating bar), plus components/dashboard/index.ts barrel and re-export through components/index.ts. HERO SLIDER: cardWidth = round(width*0.84) (~84%), symmetric sidePad = (width-cardWidth)/2 centers the active card and peeks neighbours, snapToInterval = cardWidth+GAP with decelerationRate fast + disableIntervalMomentum for clean horizontal snap, and a shared scrollX (useAnimatedScrollHandler) drives per-card interpolation: scale [0.92,1,0.92], opacity [0.6,1,0.6], translateX [22,0,-22] over [(i-1)snap, i*snap, (i+1)snap] with CLAMP - exactly the requested coverflow behavior. HERO CARD: radius via borderRadius.xl (24, in 24-28 range), shadows.lg soft elevation, expo-image fills via StyleSheet.absoluteFill with cover fit + 250ms transition, expo-linear-gradient bottom scrim, status pill states correct: done -> colors.background.card bg + colors.text.primary text; pending -> colors.brand.primary bg + colors.background.primary text; subtitle/progress derived from submitted_forms/total_forms via cardState(). PAGINATION: active dot wider (18 vs 7) and brand-colored with reanimated withSpring width + withTiming backgroundColor; inactive uses colors.border.default. HEADER/TABS: AppHeader preserved (only wrapped); active chip = colors.brand.primary bg + colors.text.inverse text, inactive = colors.background.secondary bg + colors.text.secondary text. THEME COMPLIANCE (most important check): exhaustive ripgrep for hex/rgb(a)/named colors across all new + refactored files found ZERO real violations. The only literals present are ALLOWED exceptions: rgba(0,0,0,a) used strictly inside expo-linear-gradient image scrims (HeroCard.tsx:88, HeroCarousel.tsx:178 - two scrims), and the five official social-platform brand hex values (#0A66C2 LinkedIn, #1877F2 Facebook, #E1306C Instagram, #1DA1F2 Twitter, #FF0000 YouTube) inside the preserved SocialSection icon map (dashboard/index.tsx:310-314), which are platform logo identity, explicitly allowed and noted. Brand color is accessed only via colors.brand.primary. AppHeader.tsx contains its own hardcoded colors (#1B2233, #9AA1AD, #0E1726, #F3F5F9, #E5E7EB) but it is a pre-existing preserved component explicitly out of audit scope (spec says AppHeader internals must not change), so not counted. PRESERVATION: all required behaviors intact - dashboardService + useQuery(['dashboard','content'], retry:false), onRefresh/RefreshControl (tinted with brand), useAuth, greetingForNow() three-bucket, HIDDEN_SECTIONS {rewards,careers} filtering on both tabs and sections, activeTab filtering, section ordering by meta.tabs (excluding 'all') with Object.values fallback when ordered pick is empty, Social special-casing, Presentations special card, cardState() logic verbatim, openCard routing (external -> WebBrowser, detail -> router.push content/[id] with id/type/key/slug/detailId/title/image params, fallback link -> WebBrowser), loading skeleton + error EmptyState+Retry + no-results state, and the auto-hiding floating tab bar (scroll-direction-driven reveal that snaps fully shown/hidden). api/types.ts: git diff shows the ONLY change is removal of three leftover git merge-conflict marker lines (<<<<<<< HEAD / ======= / >>>>>>>); no type definition was altered - DashboardItem, DashboardTab, DashboardSection, DashboardMeta, DashboardContentResponse and the submitted_forms/total_forms/link_type fields are all intact. Those markers were invalid syntax, so their removal is what permitted typecheck to pass; the type contract is effectively unchanged, hence preservationOk=true. DEDUCTIONS: -3 for the in-scope lint warning (unused 'spacing'), -2 for the api/types.ts touch (benign conflict-marker cleanup rather than a true no-op), -1 for minor radius variance between hero/presentation card variants, -1 for empty no-op DashboardHeader.wrap style. No hardcoded-color violations and no missing required behavior.
